name: prism-monorepo
description: Prism - AI code review platform. Monorepo containing the Next.js web app (apps/web) and the NestJS API (apps/api).

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace apps/web && npm run build --workspace apps/api
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace apps/web && npm run lint --workspace apps/api
scripts.format: npm run format --workspace apps/web && npm run format --workspace apps/api
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check --workspace apps/web && npm run format:check --workspace apps/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace apps/web && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/api
